causalLimitation: No clean native-with-all-optimizations arm exists. Effect-specific optimizations will not be synthetically rewritten onto native code, so the study reports historical checkpoint contrasts instead of claiming a complete 2x2 factorial attribution.

staticAndDevelopment: complete check on both product arms
profiles.liveAcceptance: Run configured real Provider and external-Service lanes only with fixed non-sensitive fixtures; unavailable credentials are reported as untested, never passed or skipped.

statistics.pairing: same scenario, action, terminal size, metric, and measured iteration

verdictRules: Any candidate-only deterministic behavior, security, data-integrity, cancellation, cleanup, startup-purity, or resource-leak failure blocks merge.
Every preregistered decision metric must be non-inferior; an inconclusive interval is not a pass.
A performance superiority claim requires the paired 95% interval upper bound to be at most 0.95.
A reproducible main failure that the candidate passes may establish an Effect-specific reliability advantage.
Optimizations that can be ported to native main do not by themselves justify Effect adoption.
If evidence is incomplete at the four-hour cap, the verdict is do not merge yet.
